purpose.microphone: Autoradio listens when you turn Voice on, so you can talk to the radio and ask about a story. It also records your voice when you tap Take. What you say is turned into text on this phone. A take stays on this phone unless you publish it, and then the recording is uploaded.
purpose.recordingInBackground: Autoradio keeps listening for your voice while the screen is locked, only when you have turned Voice on. Turn Voice off to stop.
purpose.speech: Autoradio turns what you say into text on this phone, to understand your request.
